info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cross-Channel Session Dialogue API
info.description: The Cross-Channel Session Dialogue API is designed to facilitate dynamic interactions between users and banking services across various channels. This API allows consumers to retrieve session dialogue details based on unique session identifiers. Fintech developers and banking service providers can utilize this endpoint to enhance user experiences by providing contextual information relevant to ongoing banking interactions. Typical use cases include customer support, personalized service offerings, and improving user engagement in digital banking platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve session dialogue for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the session dialogue details associated with the resource ID RES-100045. It provides insights into the current status and interactions captured in the session dialogue for further analysis or processing.
